nodes.title: Important
widgets_values:
## Reference Image Notes

The reference image is very important for this workflow.

For best results, the reference should be clearly visible and facing the camera. Changes in the reference size, framing, background, lighting, or composition can significantly affect the final output, so try to keep the reference as clean and consistent as possible.

When the reference is something meant to be worn, such as clothing or accessories, using a mannequin can sometimes help the model understand the item's shape, scale, and proportions. However, there is also a high chance that the mannequin itself may be carried into the generated video. Because of this, mannequin references should be used carefully.

In many cases, it may be better to use **Flux Klein** first. Since Flux Klein is an image-editing model, you can use it to modify the reference image before sending it into this workflow. For example, you can place the clothing or accessory onto a person first, then use that edited image as the reference. This can help the model understand how the item should fit, deform, or align with the body without relying directly on a mannequin reference.

This model was trained mostly with objects as references. Because of that, it may not perform as well when the reference contains people, faces, bodies, or complex character identities.

### Recommendations

Use a clean and direct reference image whenever possible.

Prefer references where the object is centered, unobstructed, and easy to identify.

Avoid references with distracting backgrounds, extreme angles, heavy shadows, unclear proportions, or unwanted elements that could be copied into the video.

For wearable items, a mannequin or simple front-facing example may help with scale and proportions, but it can also introduce unwanted mannequin features into the result.

When possible, consider using **Flux Klein** to edit or prepare the reference image first, especially for clothing, accessories, or objects that need to interact naturally with a body.

nodes.title: Important
widgets_values:
## Prompting Guide

The prompt is extremely important for this workflow.

I initially tried training this version using `@reference` to indicate the reference image, but the model did not fully converge around that format. Because of this, I cannot confirm that `@reference` is strictly required or always effective. However, I still recommend including it whenever you refer to the reference image, as it may help keep the instruction clearer and more consistent.

For best results, write the prompt in a detailed and explicit way.

This model works best with only two instruction patterns: **Add** and **Replace**.

### Add

Use this format:

`Add [description of the reference] from the @reference to/at/in [description of the target location].`

Example:

`Add a small red logo from the @reference to the upper-left corner of the jacket.`

### Replace

Use this format:

`Replace [description of the target location/object] with/by [description of the reference] from the @reference.`

Example:

`Replace the woman's T-shirt with the yellow T-shirt from the @reference.`

### Notes

Be specific about both the reference and where it should be applied.

Avoid vague prompts such as:

`Use the reference.`  
`Apply this style.`  
`Make it like the reference.`

The more clearly you describe the reference and the destination area, the better the model will follow the instruction.

If a prompt does not work well, do not assume the workflow has failed immediately. In many cases, it is better to try rewriting the prompt in a different way, with a clearer or more explicit description of the reference and the target area.

It can also be useful to experiment with the **CFG** value. Increasing the CFG may help the model follow the prompt more strongly in some cases, especially when the reference or instruction is not being applied clearly enough.

If you want to do a head swap, you can use this other LoRa of mine in conjunction - https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap/blob/main/bfs_head_v1_flux-klein_9b_step3500_rank128.safetensors

Prompt: 
head_swap: start with Picture 1 as the base image, keeping its lighting, environment, and background. remove the head from Picture 1 completely and replace it with the head from Picture 2, strictly preserving the hair, eye color, nose structure of Picture 2. copy the direction of the eye, head rotation, micro expressions from Picture 1, high quality, sharp details, 4k.

[Optional]Describe the expression in Picture 1 and copy it to the new image.

[Optional][You can describe the facial expression or other details here.]

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
# LTX-2.3

* Hugging Face: [Lightricks/LTX-2.3](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/)
* GitHub: [LTX-2](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2)

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: describe events and actions as they happen over time
2. **Visual Details**: describe all visual details you want to appear in the video
3. **Audio**: describe any sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2.3 Issues

To report issues when running this workflow, go here:
[https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

---

## Required Models and Files

### diffusion_models

**Option 1**

* [ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors)


* [ltx-2.3-22b-dev-Q6_K.gguf](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/LTX-2.3-GGUF/blob/main/ltx-2.3-22b-dev-Q6_K.gguf)


> This model requires the **distilled LoRA** if you want to generate videos in **8 steps**.

**Option 2**

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors)

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_fp8_scaled.safetensors) - Added 16-04-2026

> This models **does not require** the distilled LoRA.

---

### vaes

* [LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors)
* [LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors)

**For preview**

* [taeltx2_3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors)

---

### projection text encoder

* [ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/text_encoders/ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors)

---

### text encoder

You can download the text encoder here:

* [gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

---

### loras

**Distilled LoRAs**

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_111_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/loras/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_111_bf16.safetensors)

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors)

> If you download **ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors**, use one of the LoRAs above.

**Edit Anything — experimental, by [@Alissonerdx](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx)**

Repository: [Alissonerdx/EditAnything](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything) (prompt examples, training notes and layer reference live there).

*Edit Anything v1.1 — motion-transfer LoRA.* Pick one rank; both come from the same training (Frobenius-truncated SVD merge of the two training stages).

* [edit_anything_30k_v1.1_motion_transfer_r128.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything/resolve/main/edit_anything_30k_v1.1_motion_transfer_r128.safetensors)
* [edit_anything_30k_v1.1_motion_transfer_r256.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything/resolve/main/edit_anything_30k_v1.1_motion_transfer_r256.safetensors)

*Reference V2V (Add / Replace with a reference image).* Each build ships as a pair — load **both** files of a pair together. Pick the build you want to test; do not mix files across builds.

Original 2-extras build:

* [edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding.standard.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything/resolve/main/edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding.standard.safetensors)
* [edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding.module.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything/resolve/main/edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding.module.safetensors)

Continuation 4-extras build (adds the experimental `ref_attn` cross-attention + `ref_visual_proj`):

* [edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding-ref_attn-ref_visual_proj.standard.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything/resolve/main/edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding-ref_attn-ref_visual_proj.standard.safetensors)
* [edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding-ref_attn-ref_visual_proj.module.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything/resolve/main/edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding-ref_attn-ref_visual_proj.module.safetensors)

> Both `.standard.*` and `.module.*` files belong in the `loras/` folder. The `.standard.*` is loaded by the regular LoRA loader; the `.module.*` is loaded by `LTXVEditAnythingModuleLoader` and consumed by the `🅛🅣🅧 LTXV Edit Anything Looping Sampler`, both shipped with the **BFSnodes** custom node set.

---

### upscalers

**Spatial upscaler**

* [ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors)

**Temporal upscaler**

* [ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors)

---

## Model Folder Structure

```text
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   ├── ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors
│   │   └── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors
│   │   ├── LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── taeltx2_3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_111_bf16.safetensors
│   │   ├── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors
│   │   ├── edit_anything_30k_v1.1_motion_transfer_r128.safetensors
│   │   ├── edit_anything_30k_v1.1_motion_transfer_r256.safetensors
│   │   ├── edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding.standard.safetensors
│   │   ├── edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding.module.safetensors
│   │   ├── edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding-ref_attn-ref_visual_proj.standard.safetensors
│   │   └── edit_anything_reference_v0.1_r128_ref_adaln_proj-role_embedding-ref_attn-ref_visual_proj.module.safetensors
│   └── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│       ├── ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors
│       └── ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors
```

---

## Important Notes

* If you use **`ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors`**, you will also need the **distilled LoRA** to generate videos in **8 steps**.
* If you use **`ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors`**, the **distilled LoRA is not required**.
* **`taeltx2_3.safetensors`** is used for **preview**.
* Both **spatial** and **temporal** upscalers are optional.
* The **Edit Anything** LoRAs are experimental and require the [BFSnodes](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything) custom node set for the Reference V2V path. See the [model repository](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/EditAnything) for prompt examples, training notes and limitations.

---

## Report Issues

Before reporting any issue, make sure to update ComfyUI first:
[ComfyUI update guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)

> Note: Desktop and Cloud releases follow stable builds, so some models supported in nightly versions may not be available yet.

### Where to report each issue type

* Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
* UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
* Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
